name: Fae Second Opinion
description: Once per battle, a natural 1 on a qualifying forced-failure offensive roll grants +3 to the next offensive roll.
activationLine: Fae Second Opinion Activates! You rolled a 1. Sad.
flavor:
The supervising leaf has reviewed your roll.

It remains completely silent.

Somehow, this feels worse.

The suspicious mustached shopkeeper who's definitely not Shizuki appears from absolutely nowhere.

She looks at your roll.

She looks at you.

She slowly adjusts the mustache.

Disappointing.

Several Fae gather around to inspect your roll.

A heated discussion immediately begins.

The vote is unanimous.

Absolutely not.

A Jellyfish floats over and looks at your roll.

It doesn't have a face.

You still somehow feel judged.

Somewhere nearby, a Bubble makes a deeply disappointed *boing*.

It wasn't even involved in this.

The Fae medical team arrives.

They examine you carefully.

There appears to be nothing physically wrong with you.

This only raises further questions.

A Fae places the supervising leaf beside your roll.

The leaf is shown the evidence.

The leaf declines to comment.

The suspicious mustached shopkeeper who's definitely not Shizuki examines your roll.

"Hmm."

She writes something down.

You are fairly certain you're being charged for this.

Somewhere in the Astral Sea, an Astral Charge quietly removes itself from somebody's forehead.

It does not wish to be associated with this.

Several Jellyfish gather around your roll.

One of them slowly floats away.

The others follow.

The meeting has concluded.

A tiny Fae bell begins ringing.

Several Fae rush toward your roll carrying paperwork.

Apparently there is a procedure for this.

A familiar little giggle drifts across the Astral Sea.

You cannot see Shizuki anywhere.

Somehow, you know exactly what she's laughing at.

A Berry rolls into view.

It stops beside your roll.

There is an uncomfortable silence.

You are being judged by fruit.

The Fae stare at your roll.

The Jellyfish stare at your roll.

The suspicious shopkeeper who's definitely not Shizuki stares at your roll.

The supervising leaf supervises.

Nobody is impressed.

The supervising leaf appears.

A tiny Fae points at your roll.

The leaf is turned slightly toward you.

This feels official.
